headline: Dutch Court Bans BYD Ti7 SUV Sales in EU Over Jaguar Land Rover IP Claim
summary: A district court in The Hague banned Chinese automaker BYD from selling its Ti7 SUV in the European Union after Jaguar Land Rover alleged intellectual property infringement.
why: BYD is one of China's largest electric vehicle manufacturers, while Jaguar Land Rover is a UK-based luxury automaker owned by Tata Motors.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: A sales ban in the European Union restricts market expansion and revenue for the vehicle model.
